value_symbol_table.status: closed for the admitted function-local naming state
proof: Getter is const and walks every current named argument, basic block and instruction. Each lookup must point to that exact current Value; the count must equal the entire table size. Together these reject missing, stale and extra foreign map entries, not just a count collision.

Function text keys include table presence, maximum name length and actual uint32 LastUnique, in addition to current IR and complete block numbering. Incoming caller projections use this same functionText.

Cold output records the successful actual NameState. Replay reconstructs named current Values, checks identical table presence/MaxNameSize and complete current name-map closure, and only assigns LastUnique. It transports no Value/name-map owner.

The counter is restored before exact complete output comparison and before analysis factories and subsequent optimizer stages. SSA names are retained; no normalization weakens the equality. Invalid presence/map/max or missing helper is a failed replay and follows whole-invocation fallback.
value_symbol_table.limit: This is not a general serialization of all LLVM module state or arbitrary user/plugin pipelines. The admitted body/header/global projection and fixed default factory premises remain essential.

abi2.status: reviewed fail-closed for supported default pipeline paths
checks: Only abi_version==2 is accepted before callback-prefix reads. ABI1 of any earlier size is rejected; request_failed tail is only read at version2. Null/unsupported hooks retain original LLVM behavior.
Generic Function/Module PM and CGSCC PM check the request-owned failure flag immediately after child return, before invalidation/instrumentation-after and before using a potentially invalidated SCC.

Module-to-Function, Module-to-postorder-CGSCC, CGSCC-to-Function, devirtualization repeater and function-to-loop canonicalization check failure at their actual child-return boundaries. Legacy function PM does not verify or register skipped/unexecuted analyses.
Failure callbacks inspect Request.Failed only. Pending tokens are owned by the request; no deferred callback must dereference a deleted SCC/function to clean up.

Rust rejects late Finish status/counter failures, destroys the first complete LLVM invocation before fresh ordinary retry, and isolates reentrant compilations with lexical TLS suspension. Failed/cancelled builds do not publish products.
abi2.limit: Not an assertion that arbitrary additional plugin/custom pass managers have equivalent abort guards; only fixed admitted native pipeline is supported.

analysis_state.status: explicit reviewed domains; unknown state fresh
facts: Current registered analysis order and actual supported values, not names/IDs alone, bind entry and exit. The current FAM is cleared before replacing a function and current factories rebuild exit results. Exact resulting availability/order and full facts must match.

DT/PDT output includes ordered children/idoms/levels/root and DFS state. Public updateDFSNumbers reconstructs captured valid state on the current tree; equality is not dropped. Function BB numbers/Next/Epoch are restored separately before rebuilding analyses.

Assumption-cache empty projection is truly const, checks current Function/TTI owner and genuinely empty containers, and restores only the sealed lazy Scanned bit. LastRunTracking allows only empty/default InstCombine no-option state.

TLI includes actual per-function unavailable override bits as well as every library availability/name and ABI extension flags. TTI depends on the fixed current target/config/function factory; no old result is transported.

Local AA accepts exactly the known current default registration recipe and ordered three current dependencies (BasicAA/Scoped/TBAA); absent GlobalsAA aggregation is proven. BasicAA verifies current references and empty scratch state. The module proxy requires actual current FAM, no deferred invalidations, and only allowed cached outer analyses with genuinely empty profile summary.
LoopInfo only empty/acyclic; LoopAMProxy, global AA and other unrepresented mutable analyses stay fresh. ORE requires current function, no BFI/remarks/hotness.
analysis_state.remaining: Broader result domains and transitive SCC/global analysis reuse need their own actual field/dependency proof; the explicit analysis allowlist does not cover all LLVM analyses. The complex warm test still executes 14 function-stage groups, all 33 Module pass executions and all 16 CGSCC pass executions.

native_exact_binding.intrinsic_transport: Actual original intrinsic declaration text/complete attributes are independently bound to CURRENT declarations. Bitcode-upgraded declaration attributes are rebound to that exact original/current state before current clone, and final output equality stays mandatory.
native_exact_binding.mir: Current MMI/FunctionNumber is retained; parse binds current IR owners, original sparse MBB/analysis numbering and epochs are restored with validation, hidden alignment/force-label/predecessor order and closed-domain MFI value state are preserved. Every real MI (including bundle members) is checked. Stack/GC/EH/other owner-bearing states outside the explicit domain are rejected. native_exact_binding.capacities: Optional encoded products are bounded (stage and machine quotas/slot caps, backend active plus three LRU native epochs with aggregate logical payload cap). These are not RSS bounds: current reconstruction, old+new overlap, allocator/container/owner overhead and raw model storage remain. They do not replace language work/source budgets.
